news.titleEn: Nvidia stock suffers longest weekly losing streak since 2012 as market value sinks by $1.7 trillion
news.conclusionEn: Nvidia shares fell 13% this week, their sixth straight weekly decline, after co-founder Jensen Huang resigned as CEO on Nov. 12 amid a personal scandal, with CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO.
news.conclusionZh: 黄仁勋辞职，英伟达股价连跌六周、市值蒸发1.7万亿美元
news.whyEn: Nvidia is the bellwether of the AI trade and one of the largest weights in global indexes, so leadership uncertainty there hits chip suppliers, AI stocks and index funds worldwide.
news.whyZh: 英伟达是AI行情风向标和指数权重股，掌门人变动波及全球芯片股和指数基金
news.detailEn: Huang, who led Nvidia for 33 years, stepped down after reports of extramarital affairs, including one with an executive at a Singapore chip buyer that U.S. intelligence reportedly links to China. Shares have lost about 30% since early October, pushing Nvidia below Apple in market value. Two major investors, Altimeter's Brad Gerstner and Atreides' Gavin Baker, have urged the board to run a slow search and even consider Huang's return. Nvidia reports quarterly results on Tuesday, Nov. 17, with analysts expecting revenue of about $108.9 billion.
news.detailZh: 执掌英伟达33年的黄仁勋因婚外情曝光辞职，其中一名对象据报与美国情报部门认定涉华的新加坡芯片买家有关。自10月初以来股价累计下跌约30%，市值已被苹果反超。Altimeter和Atreides两家大股东致信董事会，要求从容遴选新CEO，甚至考虑让黄仁勋回归。英伟达将于11月17日发布季报，市场预期营收约1089亿美元。

news.titleEn: Wholesale prices rose 0.3% in October, putting annual rate at 6.5%, the highest in nearly four years
news.conclusionEn: U.S. producer prices rose 0.3% in October, slightly below forecasts, but the annual rate climbed to 6.5%, the highest since November 2022, cementing expectations of a Fed rate hike in December.
news.conclusionZh: 美国10月PPI同比升至6.5%，创近四年新高
news.whyEn: Following a hot CPI report, the data leaves markets fully pricing a Fed hike at the Dec. 8-9 meeting, which lifts borrowing costs and the dollar and pressures stocks and crypto globally.
news.whyZh: 继CPI超预期后，市场已完全押注美联储12月加息，全球融资成本承压
news.detailEn: Goods prices are up 10.2% from a year ago and intermediate goods prices rose 14.6%, showing cost pressure building in the supply chain. Fed officials worry that inflation from the Iran war, fuel prices and tariffs is spreading beyond energy. Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee said inflation is proving far more persistent than predicted. The 10-year Treasury yield held around 5.13% on Friday.
news.detailZh: 商品价格同比上涨10.2%，中间品价格同比上涨14.6%，说明供应链上游的成本压力正在累积。美联储官员担心伊朗战争、油价和关税带来的通胀正向能源以外领域扩散。芝加哥联储主席古尔斯比表示，通胀远比预期顽固。周五美国10年期国债收益率维持在5.13%左右。

news.titleEn: Russian crude production rebounds after Trump diesel deal, IEA says as oil markets return to surplus
news.conclusionEn: The IEA said global oil supply jumped 2.3 million barrels per day in October to 105.4 million, pushing the market into surplus for the first time since the Iran war began, helped by a rebound in Russian output.
news.conclusionZh: IEA称全球石油重回供过于求，俄罗斯产量反弹
news.whyEn: A return to surplus caps oil prices and eases inflation pressure for importers, even as diesel remains tight; Brent settled flat near $96 on Friday, well below October highs above $110.
news.whyZh: 供应过剩抑制油价、缓解进口国通胀，但柴油仍偏紧；布油已从110美元回落至96美元
news.detailEn: Russia's crude output rose by 210,000 barrels per day to 8.73 million in October after a Trump-Putin deal on Russian diesel and a U.S. Treasury license covering diesel trades through April 2027. Global observed inventories rose by 52 million barrels, the first increase since June. The IEA sees tentative signs of rebalancing but warns attacks on energy infrastructure still limit refined product exports. It forecasts supply to grow by 6.6 million barrels per day in 2027.
news.detailZh: 在特朗普与普京达成俄罗斯柴油协议、美国财政部发放有效期至2027年4月的柴油交易许可后，俄罗斯10月原油产量增加21万桶/日至873万桶/日。全球可观测库存增加5200万桶，为6月以来首次增长。IEA认为市场出现「初步再平衡迹象」，但能源设施遇袭仍限制成品油出口。IEA预计2027年供应将增加660万桶/日。

news.titleEn: Oil tanker catches fire after hitting naval mine in Strait of Hormuz, Iranian state media says
news.conclusionEn: Iran's navy said an oil tanker caught fire after hitting a mine in the eastern Strait of Hormuz on Saturday, a day after the IRGC claimed two more tankers exploded on an 'unauthorized' route, per a Reuters report.
news.conclusionZh: 伊朗称霍尔木兹海峡再有油轮触雷起火
news.whyEn: The strait normally carries about a fifth of the world's oil; repeated attacks keep shipping effectively shut, raising insurance and freight costs and keeping an oil risk premium in place.
news.whyZh: 霍尔木兹海峡承担全球约五分之一石油运输，持续袭击令航运近乎停摆
news.detailEn: Iran says it is escalating attacks on shipping in response to the U.S. naval blockade of its ports and tougher sanctions. None of the IRGC's claims this autumn have been independently verified, and Reuters could not immediately confirm the latest incident. The UN says at least 25 seafarers have been killed in and around the strait since the war began. A Qatari-mediated Iranian proposal for a temporary reopening is still awaiting a U.S. response.
news.detailZh: 伊朗称，升级对航运的袭击是为回应美国对其港口的海上封锁和更严厉制裁。伊斯兰革命卫队今年秋天的多次声明均未获独立证实，路透社也未能立即核实最新事件。联合国称战争爆发以来海峡及周边已有至少25名船员遇难。由卡塔尔斡旋的伊朗临时开放海峡提议仍在等待美方回应。

news.titleEn: The AI trade faces big tests next week, starting with Nvidia earnings and capped by Anthropic IPO
news.conclusionEn: Next week brings Nvidia's earnings on Tuesday, FOMC minutes on Wednesday and Anthropic's IPO, expected to price Nov. 18 at $70-$78 a share and start trading on Nasdaq as 'ANT' on Nov. 19.
news.conclusionZh: 下周英伟达财报和Anthropic上市将考验AI行情
news.whyEn: Together these events will show whether investor appetite for AI survives Nvidia's leadership crisis; Anthropic's listing would be one of the largest IPOs ever.
news.whyZh: 两大事件将检验英伟达危机后市场对AI的胃口，Anthropic或成史上最大IPO之一
news.detailEn: At the top of the range, Anthropic's offering of 825 million shares would raise about $64 billion. CNBC reports the estimated valuation has been cut to about $1.2 trillion from $2 trillion earlier in the fall. Investors will look to Nvidia's report for clarity on succession, with Ian Buck seen as an early favorite for the permanent CEO role. Retail sales, industrial production and earnings from Walmart, Home Depot and Target are also due.
news.detailZh: 按区间上限计算，Anthropic发行8.25亿股将募资约640亿美元。CNBC称其估值预期已从今年秋天早些时候的2万亿美元下调至约1.2万亿美元。投资者希望从英伟达财报中看到接班安排，Ian Buck被视为正式CEO的热门人选。下周还将公布美国零售销售、工业产出，以及沃尔玛、家得宝、Target等公司财报。

news.titleEn: Nvidia scandal draws in Commerce Secretary Lutnick, who reportedly agrees to testify about China chip sales
news.conclusionEn: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick reportedly agreed to testify before the Senate Banking Committee on Dec. 10 about Nvidia chip sales to China, and the committee also asked Jensen Huang to appear on Dec. 3.
news.conclusionZh: 美商务部长卢特尼克据报将就英伟达对华芯片出口作证
news.whyEn: The probe could lead to tighter U.S. export controls on AI chips, affecting Nvidia's sales, Asian supply chains and U.S.-China tech relations.
news.whyZh: 调查可能导致美国收紧AI芯片出口管制，影响英伟达销售和中美科技关系
news.detailEn: The scrutiny follows reports that Huang had an affair with an executive at Megaspeed, a Singapore company that bought more than $4.8 billion of advanced Nvidia chips over two years. Lawmakers are examining whether the Commerce Department enforced export controls adequately. Sen. Elizabeth Warren, set to chair the committee from January, demanded an explanation of why loopholes have not been closed. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has also criticized chip 'leakage' to China.
news.detailZh: 调查起因是报道称黄仁勋与新加坡公司Megaspeed的一名高管有染，该公司两年内采购了逾48亿美元的英伟达先进芯片。议员们正在审查商务部是否充分执行了出口管制。明年1月将接任委员会主席的参议员沃伦要求解释为何漏洞迟迟未堵。财长贝森特也公开批评芯片「外流」至中国。

news.titleEn: 'Root cause' of nationwide ground stop is unknown, FAA says
news.conclusionEn: The FAA said it still cannot identify the cause of Friday's nationwide ground stop, the longest halt of U.S. flight departures since 9/11, which appears linked to routers and networking equipment.
news.conclusionZh: 美国全国航班停飞原因仍不明，为911后最长停飞
news.whyEn: The outage exposes fragile air traffic infrastructure, hitting airlines, travelers and cargo, and puts suppliers such as L3Harris and Cisco under scrutiny.
news.whyZh: 暴露美国空管系统脆弱，冲击航空公司和货运，L3Harris、思科受关注
news.detailEn: FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford said the agency saw instability it could not explain, so it ordered the grounding. L3Harris, which owns the network, said it is supporting the investigation and has completed over 70% of a planned copper-to-fiber conversion. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy has asked Congress for $50 billion to overhaul air travel systems. The incident adds to pressure on the FAA's existing $12.5 billion modernization effort.
news.detailZh: FAA局长贝德福德表示，系统出现无法解释的不稳定，因此下令停飞。拥有该网络的L3Harris表示正配合调查，铜缆改光纤工程已完成逾70%。交通部长达菲已向国会申请500亿美元改造航空系统。此事件也让FAA现有的125亿美元现代化计划承受更大压力。

news.titleEn: AI risks are the biggest threat to the financial system, Fed survey finds
news.conclusionEn: The Fed's twice-yearly financial stability survey found 87% of respondents now cite AI as a salient risk to the financial system, up from 50% in the spring, ahead of a risk-asset correction at 52%.
news.conclusionZh: 美联储调查：AI成金融体系最大风险，提及率达87%
news.whyEn: It signals regulators and market participants see AI-driven valuations, AI financing and AI-enabled cyberattacks as the top threat to stability, which could shape future oversight.
news.whyZh: 显示监管者担忧AI估值、AI融资和AI网络攻击，可能影响未来监管方向
news.detailEn: Respondents flagged three AI concerns: stretched equity valuations that could trigger a correction, cybersecurity threats from state actors or frontier models, and complex AI-related financing. Other top risks included higher long-term rates at 48% and cyberattacks and fiscal debt at 43% each. The Fed judged the system broadly stable overall. However, hedge fund leverage is at its highest since 2013 and concentrated in a small group of funds.
news.detailZh: 受访者指出三类AI风险：股票估值过高可能引发回调、来自国家行为者或前沿AI模型的网络安全威胁，以及复杂的AI相关融资。其他主要风险包括长期利率上升（48%）、网络攻击和财政债务可持续性（各43%）。美联储认为金融体系总体稳定，但对冲基金杠杆率处于2013年以来最高，且集中在少数机构。

news.titleEn: U.S. seizes $1.2 billion in cryptocurrency stolen from Binance
news.conclusionEn: The U.S. Justice Department obtained court authorization to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion of the over $6 billion in crypto stolen from Binance on Oct. 29, a theft it blames on North Korea-linked hackers.
news.conclusionZh: 美国查扣12亿美元币安被盗加密资产
news.whyEn: It is one of the largest crypto recoveries ever and shows how state-backed hacking threatens exchanges and investors, while law enforcement is getting better at tracing funds.
news.whyZh: 史上最大规模加密资产追缴之一，凸显国家级黑客对交易所的威胁
news.detailEn: The DOJ attributes the Binance hack to North Korean military-linked actors the FBI calls 'TraderTraitor'. Government and private-sector efforts have frozen more than $2.7 billion of the stolen funds so far, and laundering through crypto channels continues. The DOJ also seized cloud infrastructure tied to a social-engineering scheme that stole over $400 million. The news comes as Bitcoin slid below $70,000 on Friday amid a stronger dollar.
news.detailZh: 美国司法部认定，币安被盗案系FBI称为「TraderTraitor」的朝鲜军方关联黑客所为。目前政府和私营机构已冻结逾27亿美元被盗资金，但洗钱活动仍在继续。司法部还查封了一个社会工程诈骗团伙的云基础设施，该团伙18个月内窃取逾4亿美元。与此同时，受美元走强影响，比特币周五跌破7万美元。

news.titleEn: COP31 Bulletin Day 6: Climate marchers call for justice as talks make limited progress
news.conclusionEn: At the halfway point of the COP31 climate summit in Antalya, Turkey, negotiations have made limited progress, with disputes over adaptation finance, a just transition mechanism and an electrification target.
news.conclusionZh: COP31气候大会过半，谈判进展有限
news.whyEn: Outcomes on climate finance and electrification targets will shape energy investment and costs for governments and companies, especially in developing countries.
news.whyZh: 气候融资和电气化目标将影响全球能源投资和发展中国家成本
news.detailEn: A draft supports Africa's call to triple adaptation finance to at least $120 billion a year by 2035, but an alternative option could reopen the COP30 finance target. Some large developing countries oppose a cover decision and sectoral targets such as raising electrification to 35% of energy use by 2035. The United States sent no official delegation after leaving the Paris Agreement again. A draft cover text is expected early next week, before the summit ends on Nov. 20.
news.detailZh: 一份草案支持非洲提出的到2035年将适应资金至少增加两倍、达到每年1200亿美元的诉求，但另一选项可能重新审议COP30的资金目标。部分发展中大国反对通过「总括决定」以及2035年电气化达到能源使用35%等行业目标。美国再次退出《巴黎协定》后未派官方代表团。总括决定草案预计下周初出炉，大会将于11月20日闭幕。

businessTips.explanationEn: A single point of failure is any one component, supplier, system or person whose breakdown stops the whole operation. Identifying SPOFs is a core part of operational resilience and risk management. The fix is usually redundancy, a backup supplier, or documented processes that others can run. It matters because the cost of a backup is usually far smaller than the cost of a total shutdown.
businessTips.explanationZh: 单点故障指一旦出问题就会让整个业务停摆的单一环节，可能是一个部件、一家供应商、一套系统或一个人。识别单点故障是运营韧性和风险管理的核心。解决办法通常是冗余备份、备用供应商，或把流程写成文档让别人也能接手。它之所以重要，是因为备份的成本通常远低于全面停摆的损失。
businessTips.exampleEn: This week's U.S. nationwide flight ground stop appears tied to networking equipment on a single air traffic network. A small business has the same risk if all bookings run through one platform account: if it gets suspended, revenue drops to zero overnight.
businessTips.exampleZh: 本周美国全国航班停飞，似乎就与单一空管网络的网络设备有关。小生意也一样：如果所有订单都依赖一个平台账号，一旦账号被封，收入一夜归零。

businessTips.explanationEn: Customer concentration risk is the danger of relying on one or a few clients for most of your revenue. A common rule of thumb is that no single customer should exceed about 20-30% of income. High concentration gives that client strong bargaining power and makes your business fragile if they leave or cut prices. Buyers and investors also value businesses with a diversified customer base more highly.
businessTips.explanationZh: 客户集中度风险是指大部分收入依赖一个或少数几个客户。常见经验法则是单一客户收入占比不宜超过20%-30%。客户过于集中会让对方掌握很强的议价权，一旦对方流失或压价，业务就会很脆弱。收购方和投资人也会给客户分散的业务更高估值。
businessTips.exampleEn: A freelance designer earning 70% of income from one agency should actively add two or three smaller clients, even at lower rates. A cleaning side business serving one property manager can list on a second platform or approach other hosts to spread the risk.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位自由设计师70%收入来自一家代理公司，就应主动再开发两三个小客户，哪怕单价低一些。只服务一个物业管理方的清洁副业，可以再上一个平台或联系其他房东来分散风险。

businessTips.explanationEn: A lock-up period is a contractual window after an IPO, typically 90 to 180 days, during which insiders and early investors cannot sell their shares. It prevents a flood of selling right after listing. When the lock-up expires, a large number of shares can suddenly become sellable, which often pressures the stock price. Investors watch lock-up expiry dates as a known supply event.
businessTips.explanationZh: 禁售期是IPO后的一段合同约定期，通常为90到180天，期间公司内部人士和早期投资者不得出售股票。它的作用是防止上市后立刻出现集中抛售。禁售期结束后，大量股票突然可以卖出，往往会压制股价。投资者会把禁售期到期日当作一个已知的「供给事件」来关注。
businessTips.exampleEn: With Anthropic expected to list on Nov. 19, its prospectus will specify when employees and early backers can start selling. An investor buying after the debut might check that date, since many newly listed stocks have historically dipped around lock-up expiry.
businessTips.exampleZh: Anthropic预计11月19日上市，其招股书会写明员工和早期投资者何时可以开始卖股。上市后买入的投资者可以留意这个日期，因为历史上很多新股在禁售期到期前后都出现过下跌。
